value.rationale: The claim gives a complete exact pointwise singularity criterion in all characteristics for a nontrivial infinite family of highly reducible Grassmannian linear sections, with local node interpretation and Gorenstein projective scheme structure. It goes beyond previously known affine component counts and existential graph singularity statements; the precise location of failure of transversality is useful in degeneration geometry.
